item.title: The Rök Runestone and the End of the World
item.description: The Rök runestone inscription is not connected to heroic deeds in war. Instead it deals with the conflict between light and darkness, warmth and cold, life and death.

item.title: Futhark 12: Corpus Editions of Runic Inscriptions
item.description: Volume 12 of Futhark: International Journal of Runic Studies (2021) is now available online. The current volume is a thematic issue dedicated to corpus editions of runic inscriptions. It contains seven peer reviewed articles, a debate article, five peer reviewed short notices and three reviews.
